skills.name: Holy Staff (降魔杖/降魔の杖)
skills.line: Evil begone! Don't you dare break the peace!
skills.description: Juzu slams her holy staff on the ground to attack a single target with a shockwave, dealing damage equal to 100% of her ATK and has a 10% base chance to inflict them with Demon's Bane, lasts 2 turns. ;Demon's Bane (降魔) : :'''Debuff, Status''': HIT is decreased by 10%.

skills.name: Karma (轮回/輪回)
skills.line: The Buddha says reincarnation follows karma... But what does that mean?
skills.description:
Each time an enemy takes an action, and if she is not immobile, Juzu gains 1 Buddhist Bead.
Zen; while under meditation, Juzu immediately gains 1 Buddhist Bead if she has none. ;Buddhist Bead (念珠) :'''General, Mark''': When she 6 Beads, she consumes all Beads to attack all enemies, dealing damage equal to 136% of her ATK and has a 30% chance of decreasing their move bar by 30%. :''(1-6 red numbered orbs with black flames will appear behind Juzu, 1 orb represents 1 layer.)''

upgrades.text: '''Buddhist Bead''': Decrease to move bar increases to 40%.
'''Buddhist Bead''': Decrease to move bar increases to 50%.

skills.name: Zen (禅意)
skills.line: "Of all those things that from a cause arise...." What's the next line again?
skills.description: Juzu meditates for 2 turns. While meditating, and if she is not immobile, each of her allies have a 40% chance of 1 debuff or control effect being dispelled (chance increases by 10% for each Buddhist Bead she has). Each debuff or control effect successfully dispelled restores that ally's HP by 3% of Juzu's max HP and increases their move bar by 30% at the cost of 1 Buddhist Bead at the end of their turn. If the dispelling fails, their RES is increased by 40%, lasts for 1 turn.

upgrades.text: Number of debuffs or control effect that can be dispelled increases to 2.
Number of debuffs or control effect that can be dispelled increases to 3.

bio.condition: With Juzu clear any zone 40 times.
